description: Source code for auxiliary functions related to PostScript fonts in the FreeType project, including table management, parsing routines, and glyph building functions.

methods.name: ps_table_new
methods.description: Initializes a PS_Table structure with specified size and memory allocator.

methods.name: ps_table_add
methods.description: Adds an object to the PS_Table, growing its memory block if necessary.

methods.name: ps_table_done
methods.description: Finalizes a PS_Table by reallocating it to its current size.

methods.name: ps_table_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a PS_Table.

methods.name: ps_parser_skip_PS_token
methods.description: Skips a PostScript token during parsing.

methods.name: ps_parser_skip_spaces
methods.description: Skips whitespace and comments in the parser.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_token
methods.description: Extracts the next token from the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_token_array
methods.description: Extracts tokens from an array within the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_tocoordarray
methods.description: Parses an array of coordinates from the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_tofixedarray
methods.description: Parses an array of fixed-point numbers from the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_tostring
methods.description: Converts a string token to a C string.

methods.name: ps_tobool
methods.description: Converts a token to a boolean value.

methods.name: ps_parser_load_field
methods.description: Loads a field value from the parser stream into an object.

methods.name: ps_parser_load_field_table
methods.description: Loads a table of fields from the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_int
methods.description: Converts the next token to an integer.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_bytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the parser stream, optionally between delimiters.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_fixed
methods.description: Reads a fixed-point number from the parser stream.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_coord_array
methods.description: Reads an array of coordinate values.

methods.name: ps_parser_to_fixed_array
methods.description: Reads an array of fixed-point values.

methods.name: ps_parser_init
methods.description: Initializes a parser object.

methods.name: ps_parser_done
methods.description: Finalizes a parser object.

methods.name: t1_builder_init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph builder for Type 1 fonts.

methods.name: t1_builder_done
methods.description: Finalizes a glyph builder, saving outline data.

methods.name: t1_builder_check_points
methods.description: Checks if there is enough space for additional points.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_point
methods.description: Adds a point to the glyph outline.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_point1
methods.description: Adds a single point to the glyph outline after checking space.

methods.name: t1_builder_add_contour
methods.description: Adds a new contour to the glyph outline.

methods.name: t1_builder_start_point
methods.description: Starts a new path with an initial point.

methods.name: t1_builder_close_contour
methods.description: Closes the current contour, possibly removing duplicate points.

methods.name: t1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a font data buffer using the Type 1 eexec cipher.
